coder_notes: Only intervention is a gene-edited NK cell therapy (excluded type); no pharmacological candidate. Eligibility allows both IDH-wildtype glioblastoma and IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma, so coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named; IDH not an entry requirement (both allowed), so no biomarker row. Normal saline flush is not a registered intervention and not listed. NK-cell persistence/phenotype in resected tumour (Group 2) is planned but relates to the cell therapy, not a candidate, so tumour_pk and target_engagement coded no. Ages include CHILD (>=12 years).
